model.note_weight_dtype: Checkpoint tensors are bf16. Widening bf16 to float32 is exact, so the float32 baseline carries exactly the checkpointed weight values.

tokenizer.encoding: tokenizers.Tokenizer.from_file(tokenizer.json).encode(text, add_special_tokens=False); no BOS or EOS inserted

heldout_text.construction: '\n\n'.join(rows of column text), tokenized once as a single stream, cut into non-overlapping windows of 512 tokens, tail dropped
heldout_text.caveat: Held out from our calibration only. It is not guaranteed absent from SmolLM2 pretraining data.
heldout_text.window_start_offsets: window i starts at token offset 512*i of the single stream
heldout_text.each_window_independent: Every window is run as its own sequence with positions 0..511, batch size one, no BOS; the first token of a window acts as the attention sink.

numerics.dtype: float32 throughout the reference forward, softmax and normalization in float32, NLL accumulated in float64
numerics.attention: explicit causal softmax, scale 1/sqrt(64), GQA by repeat_interleave of KV heads (query head h uses KV head h // 3)
numerics.masking: masked entries are -inf before softmax in the float reference; all range statistics exclude them
